note: A second reading of the same publisher, kept as its own row because the two pages do not agree with each other either. The home page publishes "20 Shoreham Rd, Red Hill South, VIC 3916" - the record's locality carrying the contact page's postcode - and embeds a Google Maps link whose place label is "20 Shoreham Road, Shoreham VIC 3916". So the operator publishes the street consistently and the locality inconsistently, and the only value all three of its own forms share is postcode 3916, which is not the 3937 on the record. Filed as a second row rather than folded into the first because superseding it or merging it would lose the fact that the operator contradicts itself.
